text:
The biggest story around Rickard Rakell isn't on the ice: NHL Trade Rumors reported this week that the Penguins are fielding calls on him, and with Pittsburgh winless in four, the timing makes sense. What a buyer would be looking at is a 33-year-old winger whose goals have mattered. His five goals have added 1.38 wins in our win model, 25th in the league, well above the 0.96 those chances usually swing.

The rest is mixed. His scoring rate is down from last season (1.72 points per 60 minutes against 2.53), and Pittsburgh's expected-goal share drops about six points with him on at five on five. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he draws the other team's best players, which explains some of that. With Bryan Rust out, he's now skating beside Sidney Crosby and Tommy Novak, which is about the best audition a player in the rumor mill can get. If those calls turn into offers, the next few games are his showcase.
headline: Fielding calls, and auditioning beside Crosby
